overclaims: McKinsey's February 22–March 5, 2024 survey reported regular organizational use at 65%, nearly double its earlier survey [e2].
In Deloitte's May–June 2024 survey, 68% reported moving no more than 30% of experiments into production [e3].
checks.note: The axis, outcome and horizon match the reviews. Two rationale sentences rely on figures the evidence does not show. e2's excerpt and Exhibit 4 cover respondents' personal use, not 65% organizational use, and nothing shows it nearly doubled. In e3's text, neither the 68% figure nor the May–June field dates appear. The e1 excerpt 'the most frequently cited barrier' leaves out its subject, 'Accuracy requirements,' so it does not show what it supports. The e2 explanation does not match the quoted excerpt.
